jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the Spatial product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll design the electrical systems behind our Spatial ALD equipment, used by leading semiconductor and optics manufacturers, world-class technology companies, universities, and research institutes around the globe.This is a hands-on engineering role. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs Spatial ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in Spatial and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Ability to design electrical systems and connections for vacuum equipment, covering both vacuum-side and atmospheric-side applications. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. jobs.title: Fast sykepleier stilling 100% ledig i hjemmetjenesten
jobs.description:
Bli med og gjør en forskjell – som sykepleier i vakre Gjemnes kommune!

Er du en engasjert og faglig sterk sykepleier som ønsker å jobbe i et miljø preget av utvikling, samarbeid og omsorg? Da har vi en spennende mulighet for deg!

Gjemnes kommune er i vekst og søker nå en sykepleier i 100 % fast stilling med oppstart 1.februar 2027. Vi er en kommune med store ambisjoner og et sterkt fokus på kvalitet i tjenestene vi leverer. Nå trenger vi DEG som vil være med og forme fremtidens hjemmetjeneste!

 Om oss

Hjemmetjenesten i Gjemnes har base på Batnfjordsøra og yter tjenester til hjemmeboende. Vi har høy faglig kompetanse og står nå foran en spennende omstilling – fra 1. september 2025 innførte vi langvaktsturnus med hovedvekt på 14,5-timers vakter.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Målrettet pleie, omsorg og rehabilitering tilpasset den enkelte pasient
  • Kartlegging og vurdering av tjenestebehov
  • Sykepleiefaglig ansvar og primær-/sekundærkontakt
  • Samarbeid med pårørende og eksterne aktører
  • Veiledning og faglig støtte til kollegaer
  • Dokumentasjon i Profil og legemiddelhåndtering

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er autorisert sykepleier
  • Er faglig trygg og selvstendig
  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Har førerkort klasse B (manuell gir)
  • Er initiativrik, fleksibel og har et brennende engasjement for pasientomsorg

 Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver
  • Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig standard
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid og fokus på brukermedvirkning
  • Kommunale biler i tjenesten
  • Lønn etter 10 års ansiennitet ved oppstart
  • Rekrutteringstillegg: kr 50 000 etter 2 år i minimum 80 % stilling
  • Medlemskap i KLP
  • En arbeidshverdag i naturskjønne omgivelser med fantastiske muligheter for friluftsliv
  • Langvaktsturnus, med vakter opptil 14,5 timer og med arbeid 4.hver helg.
  • Turnus langvakter er frivillig så det er også mulig med vanlig turnus med sein/tidligvakter og 3.hver helg. 

 Mangfold og inkludering

Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller bakgrunn. Vi tilrettelegger gjerne for deg som har behov for det.

 Søknadsfrist og videre prosess

Etter søknadsfristens utløp vil det bli utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste. Ønsker du unntak fra denne, må du begrunne det i søknaden.

Vil du være med og skape en trygg og verdig hverdag for våre innbyggere – og samtidig få en jobb med mening i et av Norges vakreste områder? Søk nå – vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Gjemnes kommune ligger på Nordmøre sentralt plassert midt mellom byene Kristiansund og Molde i Møre og Romsdal fylke. Gjemnes har ca 2750 innbyggere og et areal på ca 381 km2. Kommunesenteret ligger i tettstedet Batnfjordsøra.

jobs.title: Service/rengøringsmedarbejder søges til 10-12 timer om ugen med mulighed for mere
jobs.description:
Rengørings- og servicemedarbejder søges til KMF Properties i Hillerød området

Har du sans for rengøring, orden og detaljer – og er du samtidig en person, vi kan regne med, når der opstår noget med vores boliger? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

KMF Properties er i vækst, og vi er i gang med at udvide vores boligportefølje i Kalundborg. Derfor søger vi en stabil og ansvarsbevidst rengørings- og servicemedarbejder, som primært skal stå for rengøring og klargøring af vores boliger.

Stillingen er på 10-12 timer om ugen til at starte med, men med gode muligheder for hurtigt at få flere timer, da vi løbende får flere boliger i området.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Den største del af jobbet vil bestå af:

  • Rengøring af vores huse og boliger på alle fælles arealer, 1 gang om ugen

  • Klargøring af boliger til nye beboere

  • Rengøring ved fraflytning, inden nye beboer

  • Sørge for, at boligerne altid fremstår rene, pæne og indbydende

  • Opfyldning af forbrugsvarer

  • Tjek af boligerne og indberetning, hvis der er noget, der skal ordnes

Derudover søger vi en person, vi kan regne med

Som en del af jobbet vil du også være vores lokale kontaktperson i Kalundborg, når der opstår praktiske ting i vores boliger.

Det kan eksempelvis være, at vi har brug for dig til:

  • At køre forbi en bolig og tjekke noget

  • At hjælpe, hvis der pludselig opstår et mindre problem

  • At tage imod en håndværker eller lukke nogen ind, kun hvis der opstår et problem. Ellers burde de selv være i stand til at lukke sig ind.

  • At tjekke en bolig efter en beboer har meldt et problem

  • At hjælpe med mindre praktiske opgaver

  • At give os besked, hvis du opdager noget, der bør ordnes

Du behøver ikke være uddannet rengøringsassistent eller lign. Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt, løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er grundig og har øje for detaljer

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er fleksibel og kan træde til, når der opstår behov

  • Er serviceminded og imødekommende

  • Har en god ordenssans

  • Kan se, hvad der skal gøres, uden at vi behøver fortælle dig det hele

  • Er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorienteret

  • Har kørekort B og egen bil

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, service eller lignende – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Vi lægger først og fremmest vægt på, at du er en person, vi kan stole på, og som tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

Vi tilbyder

  • 10-12 timer om ugen til at starte med

  • Gode muligheder for hurtigt at få flere timer, efterhånden som vores boligportefølje vokser

  • En selvstændig og varieret hverdag

  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet

  • En vigtig rolle i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Mulighed for at få mere ansvar over tid

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med kort fra idé til handling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Arbejdssted

Arbejdet vil primært foregå i Hillerød og nærliggende områder.

Da KMF Properties er i gang med at udvide vores boligportefølje i området, forventer vi, at der hurtigt vil blive mulighed for flere arbejdstimer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV, hvor du kort fortæller om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor jobbet passer til dig.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

KMF Properties

jobs.title: Ekstra job som flyttemedarbejder
jobs.description:
2 flyttemedarbejdere søges til fleksibelt ekstrajob hos KMF Properties – Sjælland

Er du praktisk anlagt, fysisk stærk og har lyst til at tjene lidt ekstra ved siden af dit nuværende arbejde? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

KMF Properties er i vækst og udvider løbende vores boligportefølje på Sjælland. Når vi får nye boliger, har vi brug for hjælp til at gøre dem klar til indflytning. Derfor søger vi 2 stabile og praktiske flyttemedarbejdere, som kan hjælpe os med at klargøre vores boliger, når behovet opstår.

Jobbet er perfekt til dig, der ønsker et fleksibelt ekstrajob med mulighed for at tjene lidt ekstra et par gange om måneden.

OM JOBBET

Der er tale om et timelønnet og fleksibelt ekstrajob, hvor du bliver kontaktet, når vi får nye boliger, som skal klargøres.

Arbejdet vil typisk foregå et par gange om måneden, men antallet af opgaver vil variere afhængigt af, hvor mange nye boliger vi får.

Du bliver en vigtig del af processen med at gøre vores boliger indflytningsklare, så de er klar til vores kommende beboere.

• Flytning og indbæring af møbler og inventar• Opsætning og placering af møbler i boligerne• Samling af møbler efter behov• Installation og tilslutning af vaskemaskiner, når det er relevant og teknisk forsvarligt• Klargøring af køkkener med nødvendigt inventar og udstyr• Opsætning af nøglebokse ved boligerne• Tage billeder af boligerne, så vi kan dokumentere og præsentere dem• Generel klargøring af boliger, så de fremstår indflytningsklare• Andre praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med etablering af nye boliger

Kort sagt skal du være med til at sørge for, at vores boliger er klar til brug, uden at vi selv behøver at køre til Sjælland hver gang.

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

jobs.title: hbo-stage Bedrijfskunde: Digitalisering en Procesoptimalisatie van communicatie
jobs.description:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die enthousiaste hbo-student die het leuk vindt om organisatievraagstukken te onderzoeken en processen te verbeteren?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) wil het gebruik van papieren post verminderen en de mogelijkheden voor digitale communicatie verder uitbreiden. Dit geldt zowel voor de communicatie met bedrijven als met personen. Tijdens deze stage richt je je specifiek op de communicatie met individuele onderzoekspersonen.

Op dit moment benadert het CBS onderzoekspersonen in eerste instantie vrijwel altijd via een brief op het huisadres. Digitale communicatie, bijvoorbeeld via e-mail, biedt kansen om dit proces efficiënter, flexibeler en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Er lopen binnen het CBS al verschillende initiatieven om meer gebruik te maken van e-mailadressen, maar er zijn ook nog belangrijke vraagstukken die onderzocht moeten worden.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de volgende vragen:

  • Hoe kan het CBS op een effectieve manier e-mailadressen van onderzoekspersonen verzamelen en beheren?

  • Welke juridische en privacyvoorwaarden gelden voor het opbouwen en gebruiken van een e-maildatabase?

  • Welke technische aanpassingen en voorzieningen zijn nodig om digitale communicatie mogelijk te maken?

  • Hoe moeten de bestaande werkprocessen worden aangepast om digitale communicatie goed te ondersteunen?

  • Hoe kunnen we ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekspersonen op een toegankelijke en betrouwbare manier digitaal benaderd worden?

Samen met het Waarneeminnovatie Team en collega's van de afdeling Dataverzameling ga je dit vraagstuk onderzoeken. Je brengt de huidige situatie in kaart, onderzoekt mogelijkheden voor verbetering en werkt toe naar concrete aanbevelingen voor het CBS.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je gaat aan de slag in het Team Waarneeminnovatie. Dit team valt binnen de afdeling Dataverzameling. We zijn een jong, divers en vooral enthousiast team dat als doel heeft de waarneming van het CBS te vernieuwen en te verbeteren. 

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo-opleiding Bedrijfskunde of een soortgelijke opleiding.

  • Je hebt interesse in procesoptimalisatie, digitalisering en organisatieverandering.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, onderzoekend en neemt graag initiatief.

  • Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende betrokkenen binnen een organisatie in gesprek te gaan.

  • Je hebt een proactieve, positieve en assertieve houding en denkt in oplossingen, staat open voor feedback en gaat uitdagingen met enthousiasme aan.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samen met ervaren vakmensen bestaande processen analyseert en verbeterkansen herkent;

  • zelfstandig een praktijkgericht onderzoek of experiment opzet;

  • aan de slag gaat met het in kaart brengen van verschillende organisatorische, juridische en technische belangen en randvoorwaarden rondom digitale communicatie;

  • leert om onderzoeksresultaten te vertalen naar concrete, onderbouwde en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor het CBS.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

jobs.title: Backend Developer (Python, Java)
jobs.description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Medior Backend Developer to help build that.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

Lawyers and tax advisors ask a question in GenIA-L and get a reliable answer. That answer is what they see. What you build is everything needed to make it happen: the backend. These are the systems and connections that keep our AI product fast, secure and reliable. You join the AI team and work with our AI engineers every day. They make the product smart; you make sure that intelligence actually reaches the user. After six months, you know the code well and have shipped several new features. After that, you choose the direction you want to grow in: more towards AI, for example by improving the quality of our AI answers, or more towards DevOps, for example by improving how we automatically test and release software.

  • You build and maintain the backend of our main AI product, together with our AI engineers.

  • You build APIs and services: the connections that let the different parts of the platform talk to each other.

  • You keep an eye on code quality and make sure we follow good practices and standards.

  • You monitor and maintain our live applications and fix problems when something goes wrong.

  • You bring your own ideas on how to improve the product and the way we work.

  • You are proactive, enthusiastic, and take initiative.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently, conveying information in a concise and engaging manner.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You pick up your work independently. You don’t need much guidance, but you know when to involve a colleague.

  • You have opinions and you are not afraid to share them.

  • And you enjoy working with AI specialists on a product that is still very much in development.

  • At least 3 years of experience building Python applications that run in production and are actually used by customers.

  • Experience with FastAPI and Pydantic. Experience with LangChain or LangGraph is a plus.

  • You have built production-grade APIs that work reliably for real users.

  • You work independently within a team and don’t need hand-holding.

  • Knowledge of Postgres, GraphQL or MongoDB is a plus.

  • Some DevOps knowledge is nice to have, for example working with GitHub Actions and Helm.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

You join the AI team with one other backend engineer, three AI engineers and a Product Owner. You also work closely with the search team, the frontend team and our backend and AI leads. You report to our Lead Backend Engineer. You get a lot of freedom and room for your own opinions and ideas, in a fun team with a good work-life balance. And you can grow into a Senior or Lead Backend Engineer role.

  • A monthly base salary up to €5500 and a standard 36-hour working week.

  • An end-of-year bonus of 4% of your gross annual salary and a variable profit share of up to 6% of your gross annual salary.

  • 23 holidays and a 12% personal benefits budget, of which 8% is holiday allowance and 4% you can spend freely, for example on extra days off.

  • A good pension plan through PGB, including additional partner insurance.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometre or a public transport allowance, plus an attractive bike scheme. For employees who travel less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Hybrid working: two days a week at our office in The Hague, on Tuesday and Thursday.

  • Room to grow. In your field, in your role, in the organisation.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within a few business days. Have a few questions first? Message or call Nadine at 0628556265.

Vi lægger først og fremmest vægt på, at du er en person, vi kan stole på, og som tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

VI TILBYDER

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellowships in Economics
jobs.description:
About the positions

The Department of Economics invites applications for PhD Research Fellow positions, with a deadline of 15 January 2027. PhD Research Fellows will automatically be admitted to the Faculty of Social Sciences' PhD programme in economics and benefit from organized research training.

Our PhD programme trains economists for the international academic job market and for research positions in policy institutions, central banks, and research organisations. Our candidates also work in government, finance and the consulting sector. 

Our fellows receive thorough training in high-quality scientific research, working with state-of-the-art empirical and theoretical methods, and pursue their own research from the outset.

The Department of Economics offers an international and research-active environment with 55 faculty members and about 25 PhD students in various fields. The Department has in recent years attracted a number of prestigious ERC grants, and it hosts a centre for public economics, Norwegian Fiscal Studies (NFS) and a centre for international economics, Norwegian Centre for International Economics (NORCIE).

The Department encourages interaction between PhD students and faculty through social gatherings and a wide variety of seminars and workshops in which PhD students are fully involved. In addition to the training described above, PhD students are integrated into the Department’s international research network.

Job description

3 – 5 PhD Research Fellow positions (SKO 1017) for the PhD programme are available. The appointments are for a period of 4 years with 25% teaching and administrative duties. 

One position is funded by the Norwegian Centre for International Economics and requires that the candidate’s research interests and project proposal is related to international economics and/or development economics.

The remaining positions are not linked to specific topics or research projects. Applications from candidates in all fields of economics are encouraged, in particular in fields where the Department has a strong research base and supervision capacity.

Qualification requirements

Proven academic record: 

Candidates must hold a 2-year Master's degree (including master’s dissertation) or an equivalent qualification in economics. 

Candidates completing their Master's degrees (or equivalent) in the spring semester 2027 before 1 August, 2027, may apply.

Please note that:

  • Accounting, auditing, business, marketing or management do not count as economics.
  • Candidates who have completed a PhD programme in Economics will not be accepted. 
  • Candidates who have already been accepted to a PhD programme in Economics must inform about this.
  • Candidates from institutions that do not use ECTS grades must include an official conversion of their grades to ECTS grades.

Candidates who have already completed economics courses at the postgraduate level in econometrics, microeconomics and/or macroeconomics will have a distinct advantage in the ranking of candidates, but strong candidates who lack this background may also be accepted and will be required to take such courses as part of the PhD programme. Candidates with a degree from another institution than the University of Oslo will need to document qualifications based on detailed course descriptions and syllabuses.

GRE test

For candidates with education from an institution outside the European Economic Area/the European Union, the UK, or Switzerland a score from the general GRE test that is no more than five years old at the application deadline is required as part of the documentation of qualifications. 

  • The required scores are 152 points on the Quantitative reasoning section and 153 points on the Verbal reasoning section.
  • Please add UiO as a recipient of your GRE test using our institutional code 0756. 

You must scan and upload a copy of your test result to the application portal. 

  • The Department of Economics does not accept GMAT scores as a substitute for the GRE.

Proof of proficiency in English

A good command of English is required of all applicants. Applicants must document their proficiency in English by taking either a TOEFL or an IELTS test. 

For information about score requirements, see Requirements for admission to the PhD programme in Economics. 

Applicants are exempt from TOEFL/IELTS if they are native English speakers, have a qualifying Master’s degree from a Nordic school or have a qualifying Master’s degree where the language of tuition was English.

Working environment

It is expected that the candidate will contribute to a high standard of collegiality and the Department’s working environment. Residence in or close to Oslo is expected.

For further information, please visit the Faculty of Social Sciences’ homepage for the PhD programme: Applying for a PhD fellowship at the Faculty of Social Sciences

We offer
  • Salary NOK 590 000 to 650 000 per annum depending on qualifications. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • A comprehensive course curriculum
  • Supervision by one or two academic supervisors 
  • A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
  • A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.
  • Access to Norway’s excellent public services and welfare schemes, including generous parental leave provisions and affordable and accessible childcare (including the university’s kindergartens).
  • Fellows will be provided with an office space and will have access to all the facilities of the Department
Evaluation of the application

We seek candidates with a strong background in economics. When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the applicant's proven academic record, the project proposal and the applicant’s motivation and academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Emphasis will moreover be placed on how the project fits the research strategy of the Department of Economics and supervision capacity. For further information, please see detailed guidelines for the project proposal. 

Relevant applicants will be invited to an interview.

Application

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal of 5–10 pages
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work)
  • Copies of (both) transcripts with ECTS conversion and diplomas 

The application may also include:

  • List of relevant publications and other academic work
  • Research papers including the Master's dissertation. Where research work is co-authored, the contribution of the candidate should be indicated
  • Letters of recommendation may be included in the application but are not required. Letters of recommendation can also be sent via email to Valeriia Rava (see email address below). 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Grades from institutions not using the ECTS system must be accompanied by official conversion to ECTS grades (A-F). 

Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

 Applications without sufficient documentation will not be considered.

Contact persons
  • Head of the PhD programme, Professor Jo Thori Lind: j.t.lind@econ.uio.no
  • Adviser Valeriia Rava: valeriia.rava@econ.uio.no

Please consult our FAQ page for frequently asked questions. We are unable to review research proposals or supporting documents before the application deadline.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. 

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Economics is the highest ranked institute for economic research in Norway and in the top group in the Nordic countries. The Department offers Bachelor's and Master's programmes, as well as a doctoral programme with approximately 20 students. The department has attracted a number of ERC grants, and it hosts both a center for public economics, Norwegian Fiscal Studies (NFS) and a center for international economics, the Norwegian Centre for International Economics, which will be established in the spring of 2026.

jobs.title: Kirketjener søges til Treenighedskirken i Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Har du hænderne skruet godt på og hjertet på rette sted? Kan du lide at møde mennesker, skabe gode rammer og få praktiske ting til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye kirketjener i Treenighedskirken. Vi søger en engageret, ansvarsbevidst og imødekommende kollega, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores kirke og fællesskab. Vi er et engageret team bestående af tre præster, to organister, en kirkesanger, en kordegn/daglig leder og en kirketjener/kirke- og kulturmedarbejder, som du vil få et tæt samarbejde med om fordelingen af vagter og praktiske opgaver. Treenighedskirken er en levende kirke med mange forskellige aktiviteter. Her mødes mennesker i alle aldre til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, koncerter, foredrag og sociale arrangementer. Som kirketjener er du en af de første, vores kirkegængere og besøgende møder. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på, at du er et varmt og rummeligt menneske, der møder andre med venlighed, nærvær og respekt. Du skal kunne skabe en tryg og imødekommende atmosfære, uanset om du tager imod gæster til en festlig begivenhed eller møder mennesker i en svær livssituation. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Er venlig, omsorgsfuld og god til at møde mennesker i alle livets situationer.
  • Har et naturligt værtskab og sætter en ære i at give kirkens besøgende en god oplevelse.
  • Er selvstændig, ansvarsbevidst og god til at planlægge din arbejdsdag.
  • Har praktisk sans, ordenssans og gerne hænderne skruet godt på.
  • Trives med både faste rutiner og dage, hvor planerne ændrer sig.
  • Er fleksibel, hjælpsom og god til at samarbejde med kolleger, præster, menighedsråd og frivillige.
  • Har øje for detaljerne og tager ansvar for, at kirken og dens omgivelser fremstår pæne og indbydende.
Du behøver ikke at være uddannet kirketjener på forhånd. Hvis du ikke har gennemført den obligatoriske femugers kirketjeneruddannelse, skal den gennemføres inden for de første to år af ansættelsen. Stillingen er primært en kirketjenerstilling, som udgør 80 % af arbejdstiden, mens de resterende 20 % er afsat til opgaver som kirke- og kulturmedarbejder. Dine arbejdsopgaver Som kirketjener er du med til at skabe gode rammer om kirkens liv og aktiviteter. Arbejdsdagene er alsidige og byder på både praktiske opgaver og kontakt med mange forskellige mennesker. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:
  • Klargøring af kirken til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer.
  • At tage godt imod kirkegængere og besøgende og være en imødekommende vært.
  • Praktisk medvirken ved gudstjenester, dåb, vielser, bisættelser og begravelser.
  • At deltage i udvalgsarbejde.
  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirken og dens øvrige lokaler.
  • Indkøb og andre praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med kirkens daglige drift, herunder lettere køkkenarbejde.
  • Vedligeholdelse af kirkens udendørsarealer.
  • Snerydning foran kirkens indgange samt saltning og glatførebekæmpelse efter behov.
  • Rekvirering og koordinering af håndværkere i samarbejde med kirkeværgen.
Du bliver en vigtig del af det daglige samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sammen sørger for, at kirken er et rart sted at komme – både for menigheden, besøgende og medarbejdere. Et job med variation og fællesskab Arbejdet følger kirkens rytme, og ingen uger er helt ens. Nogle dage er præget af praktiske opgaver og forberedelser, mens andre byder på gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer med mange mennesker. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med fast fridag om mandagen og fri hver anden weekend. Arbejdstiden omfatter både dag- og aftentimer samt arbejde på helligdage. De to kirketjenere afløser hinanden ved ferie og andet fravær. Vi lægger vægt på et godt kollegialt samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udviser fleksibilitet og tager fælles ansvar for kirkens daglige liv. Vi tilbyder
  • En alsidig og meningsfuld arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver.
  • Et arbejde med stor menneskelig kontakt, hvor du gør en forskel for andre.
  • Et godt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede kolleger.
  • Mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar og indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af dine opgaver.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor både menneskelige og praktiske kompetencer bliver værdsat.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Er du nysgerrig på løn- og ansættelsesvilkår – så klik her. Har du lyst til at blive vores nye kollega? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Fortæl os lidt om dig selv, dine erfaringer, og hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde som kirketjener hos os. Vi er mindst lige så interesserede i mennesket bag CV'et som i dine formelle kvalifikationer. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller senest den 1. februar 2027. Ansøgningsfrist: den 28. november 2026, kl. 12.00 Tiltrædelse: den 1. februar 2027 eller før Ansøgning sendes til: 8907fortrolig@sogn.dk Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 10. december. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte menighedsrådsformand, Peter Hundebøll på tlf. 2944 3999. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og forhåbentlig byde dig velkommen som en del af fællesskabet i Treenighedskirken.

jobs.title: Kotisiivoojia Itä-Helsinkiin
jobs.description: Haemme ammattisiivoojia avustamaan asiakkaitamme Itä-Helsingissä.Siivoojamme auttavat asiakkaitamme ammatillisessa kotisiivouksessa. Kauttamme saat omat nimetyt asiakkaat, joiden luona käyt säännöllisesti. Työn mielekkyyttä lisää tutut asiakkaat, joihin pääset tutustumaan ja aidosti auttamaan arjessa. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme ovat ikääntyneitä (+75v) ja siivouksella on suuri merkitys heidän arkensa sujuvuuteen ja turvallisuuteen. Sen lisäksi, että näet oman käden jälkesi, luot myös merkityksellisiä suhteita asiakkaisiisi ja piristät heidän arkeaan. Hemby tarjoaa kotisiivouksia tekeville helppereillemme laadukkaat siivousvälineet mikrokuituliinoista pesuaineisiin. Kotisiivouskäynneillä voidaan hyödyntää joko asiakkaan imuria ja moppia tai Hembyn kautta saatavaa imuria ja moppia.**Mitä työ vaatii?**- Aiempaa kokemusta puhtaanapitoalalta - Asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä ja reipasta työotetta - 18 vuoden ikää - Sujuvaa suomen- tai ruotsinkielentaitoa - Nuhteeton tausta - tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen työsuhteen alussa - Eduksi katsotaan B-ajokortti sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuus **Mikä on Hemby?** Me olemme Hemby, koko perheen kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme. **Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?** Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:_"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."__"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."__"Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."_**Siivooja-helpperinä saat:**- Omat nimetyt asiakkaat, joita autat kotisiivouksessa säännöllisesti - Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-3 kertaa viikossa 2-10 tunnin ajan, riippuen asiakkaan asunnon koosta. Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti arkena klo 09-18 välisenä aikana. - Kilpailukykyisen palkan: Tuntipalkka 14,17€-16,17€/h + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. - Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän työpanoksesi ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! - Monipuolisen työn: siivoustyön lisäksi voit halutessasi myös olla avuksi asiakkaillemme arjen muissa askareissa. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksiHakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen. Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää siivooja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description:
Join us in shaping the future of maritime electrification.

ZEM is a Norwegian technology company developing and delivering advanced electric and hybrid propulsion solutions for the maritime industry. Combining deep expertise in battery technology and system integration with the industrial strength of Volvo Penta as majority owner, we are helping accelerate the transition towards more sustainable maritime operations. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a commercially driven and strategically minded Sales Director to strengthen our market position, expand our customer base, and identify new business opportunities across the maritime sector and related industries. This is a unique opportunity to join the executive management team and play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a company with proven technology, strong owners, and ambitious growth plans.

Key Responsibilities

Market Development and Relationship Building

  • Build and develop relationships with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers, OEMs and other key industry stakeholders.
  • Open new customer accounts and expand ZEM's presence in existing and emerging market segments.
  • Represent ZEM at customer locations, industry events, conferences and trade fairs.
  • Strengthen and expand the company's network across priority markets and geographies.
  • Further develop existing customer relationships together with technical and service teams, including upselling, aftermarket opportunities and new projects.
  • Own and develop the commercial relationship with Volvo Penta and support joint market development initiatives.

Business Opportunity Development

  • Identify future projects, investment plans and market opportunities at an early stage.
  • Understand customer needs, decision-making processes and commercial drivers.
  • Qualify opportunities and build a strong pipeline of future business.
  • Lead tender and contract processes for own customers and opportunities transferred from business development activities.
  • Ensure effective handover and collaboration across internal stakeholders.
  • Commercial Strategy and Market Positioning
  • Contribute to the development of ZEMs commercial strategy, value proposition and market positioning.
  • Provide market intelligence and customer insight to support strategic decision-making.
  • Monitor market developments, regulatory changes and competitive activity.
  • Act as a trusted market voice within the executive management team.

Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Business and Sales Development Engineer.
  • Contribute actively as a member of the management team.
  • Help shape market priorities, commercial processes and growth initiatives.
Required Qualifications
  • Extensive experience from commercial leadership, sales or business development roles within the maritime sector, offshore industry or related heavy industry.
  • A strong and relevant network among Norwegian shipowners, shipyards, OEMs or other key maritime stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of opening new customer relationships and securing business in complex B2B environments.
  • Experience managing long sales cycles and cultivating strategic customer relationships over time.
  • Ability to engage credibly in discussions related to electrification, propulsion systems, battery technology or maritime operations.
  • Excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently, approximately 40–60% of working time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in engineering, maritime studies, business or a related discipline.
  • Experience with maritime electrification, hybrid propulsion, energy storage or maritime system integration.
  • International business development and sales experience.
  • An established network beyond Norway within the maritime and offshore industries.
  • Experience influencing technology selection, specifications and project requirements during the early phases of customer projects.
Who we believe you are
  • You are commercially driven, curious and highly relationship-oriented.
  • You thrive in customer-facing environments and are comfortable navigating between boardrooms, shipyards, project teams and industry events.
  • You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are motivated by creating opportunities where none previously existed. You are patient enough to build trust over time, yet proactive enough to create momentum and drive measurable progress.
  • Most importantly, you enjoy opening doors, understanding customer challenges, and turning long-term relationships into sustainable business growth.
What we offer
  • A key leadership position in a company at the forefront of maritime electrification.
  • Membership of the executive management team with direct influence on strategy, market priorities and business growth.
  • The opportunity to help shape new markets and create long-term commercial value.
  • Proven technology, strong technical expertise and industrial backing from Volvo Penta.
  • Close collaboration with experienced leaders, engineers and industry specialists.
  • A high degree of autonomy and ownership.
  • The opportunity to contribute directly to reducing emissions and accelerating the green transition in the maritime sector.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

If you are excited by the opportunity to build markets, develop strategic customer relationships and help shape the future of sustainable maritime technology, we would love to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible.

KontaktinformasjonJonathan Sørbye, CEO, 90675809 Guro Rognerud Gaarder, Recruiter, 93441660, guro.gaarder@buhr.no ArbeidsstedVeritasveien 20 1363 HØVIK Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: ZEM AS Referansenr.: 5209527562 Stillingsprosent: 100% Permanent position Søknadsfrist: 27.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ZEM (Zero Emission Maritime Solutions) is a Norwegian pioneer in green maritime technology. We design and deliver complete battery systems and electric/hybrid propulsion solutions for ships and vessels – with one clear mission: to reduce emissions and accelerate the green transition at sea.

Based in Høvik and with roots dating back to 1993, we have supplied solutions to more than 150 vessels, from aquaculture work boats to ferries to offshore ships. Our expertise combines decades of electrification experience with cutting-edge innovation in the maritime sector. As part of the Volvo Penta family, we benefit from global technology and networks while maintaining the agility and entrepreneurial spirit that defines us. We are growing fast – in revenue, in team size, and in impact – and have been recognized as a “Gaselle company” four years in a row. At ZEM, you’ll help shape the future of maritime and contribute to a more sustainable world.

jobs.title: Account Manager (Coordinator)

jobs.title: SURF Umbilical Specialist
jobs.description:
Erithy, previously known as Be Better Contractors, specializes in the design and construction of sustainable subsea infrastructure globally.

We deliver consultancy services within the oil and gas industry, high voltage cables, biogas and hydrogen, as well as civil engineering services and project administration.

Created in 2017, Erithy has grown into a consultancy team made up of various profiles from Europe, South America and the Middle East, working on projects across Norway.

We are always on the lookout for new talented individuals to join our team, and we hope that you will be our new member!

We are now looking for a SURF Umbilical Specialist for one of our customers based in Oslo.

Duration: 1 year, with option for extension

Responsibilities:

  • Provide high standard services with regards to H3SE&Q, so to implement and to control H3SE rules and requirements within his area of responsibility. Ensure all flowlines technical documentation and SURF Contractor activities comply with H3SE&Q requirements and highlight any potential deviations. Ensure safe working practices are implemented along all phases of project

  • Provide high level support services to ensure compliance with the Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy, promote and enforce the Anti-Corruption Program within the Project

  • Be responsible for all FEED umbilicals engineering activities and manage all FEED contractor technical activities related to his/her discipline

  • Be responsible for preparation and timely delivery of the umbilical sub-system (2-off Dynamic Umbilicals and, 27-off static umbilicals) Call For Tender technical package of the SURF EPCI Contract, considering the impact of other SURF/FPSO/SPS sub-systems (Steel Lazy Wave Risers, FPSO mooring lines, future risers/umbilicals development)

  • Be responsible to review, fitness for purpose and compliance to Project and Company requirements of SURF Tenderers Technical offers. Lead the technical clarifications with Tenderers and ensure timely closing of Technical qualifications. Carry out Tenders technical evaluation and support for preparation of RTA technical part

  • Define, develop, issue and maintain all necessary technical documentation related to the umbilicals design and installation activities. Support and participate to the development and maintenance of Project Management main documents (SOR, FDP, PEP, PQP, Risks, etc.)

  • Ensure follow-up / review / validation of progress performed by SURF Contractor and its Suppliers with regards to his/her disciplines and analyze/report drifts that could occur and propose remedial solutions

  • The Service Holder shall proactively provide alternative designs or technical solutions whenever required, accounting for the various constraints of project packages, such as reducing as much as possible the hookup and in-place loads to minimize dynamic umbilicals fatigue, mitigate potential clashes with other SURF items (SLWR and mooring lines), assist the Installation Lead to optimize the SLWR/Umbilicals wet parking configurations and sub-sequent transfer activities to FPSO, assist SLWR Engineers in Orcaflex studies, etc…

  • Supervise and control the detailed engineering by timely reviewing the disciplines-related documentation issued by SURF Contractor (technical documentation / queries / derogation requests...), in order to ensure compliance with Project Specifications and Procedures (when applicable), international norms and standards with the objective to ensure respect of the schedule and to optimize costs without impacting required level of Quality and Safety

  • Raise consequently necessary comments and highlight unsafe design, deviations, unacceptable / unjustified design choices, constructability issues

  • Act, as technical referent vis-à-vis Contractor(s) for umbilicals matters, and follow-up the Suppliers providing equipment for the umbilicals, e.g.: bend stiffeners, bend stiffener latching mechanism, bend restrictors, buoyancy, VIV strakes…

  • Ensure technical compliance throughout the Project life of the engineered, procured, fabricated, tested and installed umbilicals. Ensure all technical, QA/QC and H3SE project policies and requirements are duly implemented and ensure Contractors’ compliance with contractual requirements in all areas. Anticipate and ensure adequate and timely reporting to the Technical Manager of any concern, issue or potential deviation. Propose timely and adequate solutions and optimizations

  • Ensure that his/her work is in line with umbilicals specialists of Company Headquarters

  • Liaise with other package teams (SPS, FPSO) for interface matters with the support of Interface Managers and leads

  • Organize and participate to Project Reviews

  • Assist and support the Technical Manager and the Subsea Manager on all aspects of the umbilicals activities related Call For Tender, Clarification & evaluation process, project execution and contracts management, and with the relations with Partners

  • Coordinate with other Team Members including the SURF contract engineer for the follow-up of correspondence and contract activities throughout the full CFT process and during Project Execution

  • Participate to the Installation Phase, tests, commissioning and handover, assisting when necessary, the Installation Leader during all the offshore work campaigns.

  • Gather ‘lessons learnt’ and provide feedback to Company entities as required. Assist in the formalization of the close-out report

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in engineering field

  • Languages: English

  • At least 10 years in large offshore oil & gas SURF deep water projects

  • Experience in umbilical design on EPCI projects.

  • Good knowledge of relevant codes (DNV) and Company General Specifications, procedures and policies is preferred

  • Preferably, previous experience with Major SURF Contractors during project execution for deep water project and follow-up of the engineering and procurement of umbilicals

  • Preferably, previous experience with Umbilical Manufacturing Supplier

  • Positive, constructive, proactive and pragmatic mindset

  • Ability to work within large teams with other parties (Contractors, suppliers, HQ technical teams, etc)

  • Previous experience within a complex and multicultural working environment

To work with Erithy means:

  • Working on exciting Norwegian energy projects.

  • Fast-track your career as a consultant for one of our customers.

  • We offer opportunities for permanent employment, where stability and personal development are the main focus.

  • Access our network of consultants and customers, and expand your opportunities.

  • In Erithy, we care and know our consultants on a personal level, and follow-up their progression.

Join Erithy now!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a company that specialize in consultancy services, bringing expertise in engineering, management, operations, and design.

jobs.title: Myndighedschef til børne- og familieområdet i Frederiksberg Kommune
jobs.description:
Myndighedschef til børne- og familieområdet i Frederiksberg Kommune 

Er du en dygtig og erfaren leder indenfor det specialiserede børneområde, og vil du stå i spidsen for, at familieafdelingen i Frederiksberg tager næste skridt på vejen til at blive Danmarks bedste, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. 

Vi leder efter en inspirerende leder, som er lige dele dedikeret, målrettet, samarbejdsorienteret og uhøjtidelig. 

Hvis det kan være dig, skal du læse videre. 

I familieafdelingen i Frederiksberg Kommune har vi tårnhøje ambitioner for den faglige kvalitet i sagsbehandlingen for udsatte og handicappede børn og unge. Vi lægger stor vægt på nærværende faglig ledelse, som en afgørende forudsætning for, at vores indsats skal gøre en reel forskel i børn og unges liv. Vi arbejder målrettet med at sikre, at intentionerne i barnets lov slår tydeligt igennem i vores praksis, så de løsninger der bliver iværksat, står på et sikkert fundament af inddragelse og samarbejde med børn, forældre, netværk, civilsamfund og professionelle samarbejdspartnere. Vi ved, at den specialiserede støtte virker bedst, når den tager udgangspunkt i tidlig opsporing, og indgår i et velfungerende samarbejde mellem de betydningsfulde voksne omkring barnet. 

I Familieafdelingen består af ca. 110 dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, hvoraf de fleste er børne- ungerådgivere. Sammen har vi ansvar for ca. 1200 løbende børnesager, vi behandler årligt omkring 2300 underretninger og forvalter et samlet budget på ca. 350 mio. kr. Afdelingen er organiseret i fem sektioner med hver sin leder og socialfaglige koordinator. Én sektion arbejder med de børn og unge, som er anbragt udenfor hjemmet og én sektion med børn og unge med funktionsnedsættelser. De tre øvrige sektioner kalder vi forebyggelsessektioner. De tager sig af sagsarbejdet fra modtagelsen af en underretning til afslutningen af en sag for de mange børn og unge, der modtager forebyggende støtteindsatser. I afdelingen er der også et tværfagligt sekretariat, og en række understøttende specialist- og konsulentfunktioner. På leverandørsiden samarbejder vi blandt andet med kommunale tilbud, to selvejende institutioner med driftsoverenskomst og en lang række eksterne private tilbud, plejefamilier og regionstilbud. 

Vi søger en myndighedschef, som skal stå i spidsen for afdelingen og have det tværgående faglige, økonomiske og personalemæssige ansvar, og som kan skabe gode rammer for et velfungerende arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejderne trives og bliver endnu dygtigere. Som myndighedschef er du nærmeste leder for de fem sektionsledere og en teamleder, og du skal sammen med ledergruppen gå forrest i at sikre effektiv og stabil drift, faglig udvikling og samarbejde med vores kollegaer i udfører-tilbud, skoler, dagtilbud, fritidsområdet mv.  

Du referer til Vicedirektøren, som i samarbejde med Børne- og socialdirektøren har ansvaret for den politiske betjening, og den strategiske og styringsmæssige ledelse af det samlede socialområde (børn og voksne). 

Du skal søge stillingen, hvis du; 

  • Er en rutineret leder med dedikeret interesse for og erfaring fra børne- og familieområdet Det er et must, at du kender myndighedsopgaven indgående og har hjerte og holdning til, hvordan det gode sociale arbejde ser ud anno 2026  
  • Mestrer oversættelsesopgaven op, ned og til siden og kan lede, motivere, sætte tydelig retning og skabe følgeskab  
  • Tænker og arbejder strategisk, er handlekraftig og har et godt overblik. Du betragter styring, økonomiske, juridiske og organisatoriske rammer, som naturlige hjørneflag for det socialfaglige arbejde 
  • Har et stærkt fokus på faglig kvalitet og øje for, hvordan familieafdelingens arbejde opleves af dem, det skal gøre en forskel for 
  • Har stærke relationelle kompetencer og er optaget af at styrke det tværfaglige samarbejde med fagprofessionelle i og udenfor kommunen 
  • Kommunikerer præcist i både skrift og tale 

Vi lægger også vægt på, at du selv og andre kan genkende at du; 

  • Har en nysgerrig og åben tilgang og udstråler naturlig autoritet 
  • Trives i travlhed og kompleksitet og kan bevare ro og overskud i håndteringen af alvorlige og akutte problemstillinger  
  • Har let til smil og kan bidrage til en uformel samarbejdskultur, men også kan håndtere konflikter og træde i karakter, når situationen kalder på det  
  • Møder andre med positive forventninger og kan se bag om  

Ansættelsesproces Ansøgningsfrist tirsdag den 8. december 2026 kl. 23:59. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes den 14. og den 18. december. For ansøgere, der går videre til anden runde, vil der indgå test, ligesom vi indhenter referencer mellem 1. og 2. samtale.  Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til chefaftale og kvalifikationer. Vi forventer at stillingen tiltrædes 1. februar 2027. Hvis du har spørgsmål og overvejer at søge, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte vicedirektør Kristina Mikkelsen på telefon 26776598 eller sektionsleder Sine Nissen på telefon 28983600  Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden. Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 106.480 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, etnisk tilhørsforhold eller handicap.

jobs.title: Medarbetare för hemstädning
jobs.description: Vi på Vältjänster erbjuder våra kunder ett brett utbud av hemservicetjänster, majoriteten av våra kunder är pensionärer. Just nu söker vi en medarbetare som i första hand ska jobba med hemstädning hos våra kunder. Till en början sker arbetet några timmar per vecka men utökas varefter kundantalet ökar. jobs.title: SiS ungdomshem Stigby söker behandlingspedagog 75% natt
jobs.description: Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring. SiS ungdomshem Stigby på Visingsö har plats för 35 ungdomar och tar emot icke skolpliktiga pojkar med psykosocial problematik, kriminalitet och missbruk. Vi är uppdelad på en MBB-avdelning (mottagning- och behovsbedömning), fyra behandlingsavdelningar och en utskrivningsförberedande avdelning i Jönköping. ArbetsbeskrivningSom behandlingspedagog natt hjälper du ungdomar rätt i livet genom att vara en trygg och stabil förebild. Du har ansvar för avdelningens inre och yttre miljö nattetid. Tjänstgöringen innebär att du är en av sju personal som tjänstgör natt på institutionen. Arbetet innebär bland annat tillsynsuppgifter samt dokumentation på avdelningen. Det ingår även att rondera över hela institutionen, där du ansvarar för att upprätthålla säkerhet och brandskydd under nattetid och samtidigt ansvara för tillsynen av ungdomar. Som behandlingspersonal nattetid har du ständigt vaken tjänstgöring. Arbetet kräver mycket självständighet, noggrannhet och kunskaper kring arbetsmiljö och säkerhet.Andra arbetsuppgifter kan vara:    Dokumentation i journalsystem (KAJ)    Vara behjälplig vid diverse kvällsrutiner samt läggning    Vara behjälplig med diverse morgonrutiner Vi arbetar utifrån våra värdeord: Respekt, Omtanke och Tydlighet.Arbetstiden är förlagd nattetid med vaken tjänstgöring. Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt. Kvalifikationer För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt. Du har ett intresse av att arbeta med utsatta ungdomar som behöver stöd och är en god vuxen förebild. Du kan dela med dig av din trygghet och stabilitet. Att du är en kollega som delar kunskap och bidrar till vikänslan på SiS är andra egenskaper som gör dig intressant.Du ska också ha:    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig    Erfarenhet av arbete med människor i en utsatt livssituation t.ex. från institutionsplaceringar, psykiatri, HVB- verksamehet eller från vård- och omsorg    B- körkort    God svenska i tal och skriftPå SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/. Anställning: Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning 75 % vaken natt (enligt schema) och inleds med sex månaders provanställning.Tillträde: 2027-01-04 eller enligt överenskommelse. jobs.title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics. Subject description Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks. Project description RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects. Duties As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas: Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments a. Agentic planning and reasoning - Semantic mission planning using foundation models - Task decomposition based on foundation models - Event-driven task replanning b. Autonomous inspection planning - Uncertainty aware planning - Multi-agent systems for inspection planning Qualifications To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required. For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en. jobs.title: Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer
jobs.description:
Erithy, previously known as Be Better Contractors, specializes in the design and construction of sustainable subsea infrastructure globally.

We deliver consultancy services within the oil and gas industry, high voltage cables, biogas and hydrogen, as well as civil engineering services and project administration.

Created in 2017, Erithy has grown into a consultancy team made up of various profiles from Europe, South America and the Middle East, working on projects across Norway.

We are always on the lookout for new talented individuals to join our team, and we hope that you will be our new member!

We are now looking for a Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer for one of our customers based in Stavanger.

Duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension. Start ASAP

Deadline for applications: 19.11.2026

Responsibilities:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer for a consultancy assignment of one year, with the possibility of adjustment, in the Asset Integrity & Maintenance Team for one of our operated offshore assets. In our operating model, the asset team is end-to-end accountable for technical and operational integrity, including barrier management, across all time horizons and in compliance with regulations and our management system. The discipline engineers in the team are multi-skilled, have close-to-full-time allocation to the asset, and are supported by the Portfolio Engineering team and subject matter experts for specialist and complex tasks. This is a senior role: the consultant will be expected to take full ownership of technical safety on the asset from day one, with minimal onboarding.

As Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer you will be the asset's day-to-day point of contact for technical safety. You are responsible for the technical safety equipment on the asset and the associated performance standards, and for ensuring that barriers are maintained, monitored and followed up in line with the risk picture. You will be followed up by the Technical Safety & Barrier Management department, which provides peer support and quality assurance.

  • Provide day-to-day technical safety support to the asset team and the offshore organisation.

  • Own and follow up technical safety equipment and associated performance standards (e.g. fire and gas detection, emergency shutdown, firewater and deluge, passive fire protection, ignition source control, escape, evacuation and lifesaving equipment).

  • Monitor barrier status, follow up degraded barriers and define robust compensating measures to maintain the safety level.

  • Assess risk related to deviations, dispensations, temporary changes and reduced functionality of equipment, and handle cases in the relevant tools (e.g. Synergi).

  • Follow up test and maintenance results for safety-critical equipment, including offshore participation in firewater and deluge tests, and contribute to performance standard compliance verification.

  • Provide technical safety input to management of change, modifications and work orders, and participate in or facilitate HAZID, HAZOP and design reviews.

  • Contribute to updates of risk analyses (TRA/QRA) and emergency preparedness analyses, and follow up resulting actions and assumptions in operation.

  • Interface with Portfolio Engineering, technical safety SMEs, barrier management advisors and other disciplines, and support audits and supervisory activities from the authorities.

Requirements:

  • MSc or BSc in engineering (e.g. safety, process, mechanical or similar).

  • Minimum 10 years of experience within technical safety, of which at least 5 years from technical safety in operations of offshore installations, preferably on the Norwegian continental shelf.

  • Good knowledge of the Norwegian regulations (Havtil) and relevant standards, e.g. NORSOK S-001, ISO 13702, IEC 61508/61511 and Offshore Norge Guideline 070.

  • Proven experience with barrier management in operation, including ownership of performance standards, follow-up of degraded barriers and definition of compensating measures.

  • Fluent in Norwegian and English, written and spoken.

  • Documented ability to work independently and take full ownership of technical safety for an operating asset from day one, without an extended onboarding period.

  • Valid offshore safety course and health certificate, or willingness to obtain them, and willingness to travel offshore.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience with risk-based deviation handling and management of change in an operator organisation.

  • Knowledge of NORSOK Z-013 and use of risk analysis results in decision-making.

  • Familiarity with SAP, Synergi and digital barrier status tools.

  • Experience from FPSO or production installations on the Norwegian continental shelf.

  • Experience as discipline engineer or technical safety responsible in an operator's asset or operations organisation.

Personal qualities:

  • Experienced and confident, with the credibility to make and justify technical safety decisions independently in a busy operational environment.

  • Communicates clearly with offshore personnel, discipline engineers and management alike.

  • Proactive and collaborative, with a genuine interest in safety and continuous improvement

To work with Erithy means:

  • Working on exciting Norwegian energy projects.

  • Fast-track your career as a consultant for one of our customers.

  • We offer opportunities for permanent employment, where stability and personal development are the main focus.

  • Access our network of consultants and customers, and expand your opportunities.

  • In Erithy, we care and know our consultants on a personal level, and follow-up their progression.

Join Erithy now!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a company that specialize in consultancy services, bringing expertise in engineering, management, operations, and design.

jobs.title: Vil du ha en jobb litt utenom det vanlige? Assistent søkes til 90% fast stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du ha en jobb litt utenom det vanlige? Assistent søkes til 90% fast stilling

Jeg er en kvinne i midten av 30-årene som søker en ny brukerstyrt personlig assistent (BPA) som fast til nær fulltidsstilling i teamet mitt. Jeg ser spesielt etter deg som ønsker dette som din hovedjobb, ser verdien i å ha en ufaglært jobb der vår kjemi teller mer enn cv-en din og at du har ønske om et langvarig ansettelsesforhold.

Ved ferieavvikling og sykefravær hos de andre faste ansatte er det fint om du er innstilt å ta andre/flere vakter enn din ordinære turnus

Jeg er utdannet journalist og jobber med å fullføre en mastergrad. Hverdagen min varierer mye, og jeg trenger assistanse til det meste av fysiske gjøremål gjennom hele døgnet.

Jeg har assistanse 24 timer i døgnet, hele året – det betyr at du som fast ansatt må være innstilt på at helligdager også er en del av turnusen hos meg. Vi lager dog egen turnus for sommer og jul slik at alle også får avviklet egen ferie.

For tiden er jeg mye hjemme i påvente av en operasjon, og dagene mine er preget av en del smerter. Dette er noe du må være komfortabel med at blir en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen. Samtidig, når formen tillater det, liker jeg å komme meg ut – enten det er kulturopplevelser i Oslo, sosiale aktiviteter eller tid med venner.

Som den jeg har ansatt i størst stilling er det også viktig at du forstår at livet består av flest hverdager. Akkurat nå er hverdagene mine preget av mye tid på Sats og flittig bruk av kjøkkenvekt. Jeg må nemlig ned i vekt før operasjon kan skje. Generelt bør du tåle at jeg tenker selv og du utfører det jeg selv ikke fysisk mestrer. Kun fantasien min setter grenser her, så det betyr at arbeidsoppgavene innimellom kan være litt utradisjonelle (ikke farlige selvsagt, men jeg skal gi deg et eksempel: Jeg bestilte ny seng den var for høy til at jeg fikk lagt meg i den, jeg tok på stiletthæler og biffen var løst til sengebeina kunne byttes.) Så det hjelper absolutt om du er positivt innstilt til rare påfunn. Og at du selv er en person som ser løsninger fremfor begrensninger.

Hos meg vet du aldri helt hvordan dagen blir. Noen dager er rolige hjemme, andre er mer aktive og foregår ute av huset. Derfor passer denne stillingen spesielt godt for deg som trives med variasjon og kan tilpasse deg ulike situasjoner.

Stillingen som er ledig:

Jeg søker deg som er interessert i en fast stilling på gjennomsnittlig 32 timer i uka (det er fullt mulig å ta på seg ekstra vakter/timer så stillingen blir 100%) fordelt slik:

Hver mandag 08.00-16.00

Hver tirsdag 07.00-16.00

Hver onsdag 07.00-16.00

Arbeid hver 4. helg:

- Fredag kveld 16.00-01.00

- Lørdag dag 09.00-17.00

- Søndag kveld 17.00-24.00

Noe fleksibilitet må beregnes i stillingen.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Jobben handler om å assistere meg i alle livets situasjoner, og det er mange av dem! Du vil hjelpe til med alt fra forflytning, praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, være med på alt fra legebesøk til reiser, konserter, bursdager – og ganske enkelt sørge for at jeg får gjort det jeg har lyst til.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg søker deg som ser etter et langsiktig arbeidsforhold, slik at vi kan bli godt kjent og jeg kan få stabilitet i livet og du får en forutsigbar arbeidshverdag.

Du trenger ikke ha erfaring – opplæring gis, men det viktigste er personlig kjemi og gode egenskaper. Jeg ser etter deg som:

- Er kvinne (av hensyn til jobbens intime karakter)

- Snakker og skriver flytende norsk

- Er trygg, fleksibel og løsningsorientert

- Er fysisk sterk og tåler forflytninger og aktivitet

- Har respekt for at du jobber tett på et annet menneske

- Takler både gode og dårlige dager

- Ønsker en jobb med variasjoner - og gjerne erfaring fra serviceyrker

Hva får du?

Tarifflønn, med ansiennitet

Pensjon og forsikring (inkl. AFP)

Trygt og ryddig arbeidsforhold

God opplæring og støtte

Assistentkurs gjennom Humana

Tilgang til ansattfordeler:

Rabatt på SATS og Nr1 Fitness

Ansatt-hytte på Hovden

Visma LogBuy-fordelsprogram

Brukervennlig app for rutiner og vaktplan

En meningsfull jobb, hvor du gjør en reell forskjell i et annet menneskes liv

Arbeidssted:

Primært hjemme hos meg i Nydalen, Oslo, men du blir også med meg ut i verden – det kan være til sykehus, konserter, ferie eller alle hendelser livet byr på.

Oppstart:

Snarest mulig

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.
