UVJETI: prema članku 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, broj: 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26), Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (Narodne novine, broj 145/2024) i Pravilnika o unutarnjem ustrojstvu i načinu rada Dječjeg vrtića Cvrčak Virovitica: kvalifikacija razine 1 stečena završetkom osnovnog obrazovanja. Pored navedenih uvjeta, kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u radni odnos: 1. hrvatsko državljanstvo 2. zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta - dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta kandidat je dužan dostaviti po obavijesti o izboru, a prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa 3. radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke definirane člankom 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26). Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj u kojoj kandidat navodi osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, kontakt broj, adresa elektroničke pošte) sa naznakom radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje, potrebno je priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz natječaja i to kako slijedi:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi i struci ( preslika diplome, svjedodžbe)
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika osobne iskaznice, domovnice, putovnice)
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima i radnom stažu evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje s naznakom roka izdavanja/ne starije od mjesec dana
  • dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26):
    1. potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (članak 25. stavak 2.) ne starije od 6 mjeseci
    2. potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (članak 25. stavak 4.) ne starije od 6 mjeseci
    3. potvrdu nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju ne starije od 6 mjeseci.
Kandidati dokumente dostavljaju isključivo u neovjerenim preslikama. Na natječaj se pod ravnopravnim uvjetima mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je pored dokaza o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o pravima hrvatskih branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji, dužan je pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta dostaviti sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. navedenog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanja dostupni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja (https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843), a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni u svrhu ostvarivanja prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražite na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 27/92, 27/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zapošljavanje-843/843. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i urednu prijavu sa svim prilozima te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji ne ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja obavijestiti će se o tome pisanim putem. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči vrtića i to od 12. 11. 2026. do 20. 11. 2026. godine. Prijave na natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se preporučenom poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić Cvrčak Virovitica, Pejačevićeva 1, 33000 Virovitica uz naznaku: „Za natječaj – neodređeno – spremač/ica“ Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja te koji su podnijeli prijave pravovremenom i s potpunom dokumentacijom provest će se postupak procjene/testiranja i vrednovanja kandidata radi provjere znanja, sposobnosti i vještina bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta. Ako kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete natječaja, ne pristupi procjeni/testiranju i vrednovanju, smatrat će se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj. Obavijest o načinu procjene/testiranja i vrednovanja kandidata, područje provjere, pravni i drugi izvori za pripremu kandidata za procjenu/testiranje i vrednovanje, vrijeme i mjesto održavanja procjene/testiranja i vrednovanja kandidata objaviti će se na mrežnim stranicama Dječjeg vrtića Cvrčak Virovitica https://www.cvrcakvt.hr/dokumenti/Natjecaji/, najmanje pet dana prije dana određenog za procjenu/testiranje i vrednovanje. Radi zaštite osobnih podataka, rezultate, obavijesti i slično objaviti ćemo u obliku inicijala i datuma rođenja. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem u zakonskom roku. Vrtić zadržava pravo poništiti natječaj. Prijavom na natječaj, kandidat je dao privolu za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih i drugih podataka a podaci će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i rezultata natječaja, sukladno Uredbi (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka).

Das Vorhaben ist Teil des Aufbaus eines modernen IT Control Centers.   • Nachweisbare Verantwortung für mindestens eine End-to-End-Einführung oder Migration einer Enterprise-ITSM-Plattform, von der Initialisierung und dem Solution Design bis zum Go-live und zur Betriebsübergabe

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Incident und Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Service Request Management, Change Enablement, Service Catalogue und Knowledge Management

  • Erfahrung mit CMDB und Configuration Management, Monitoring und Event Management sowie komplexen ITSM-Integrationen und Datenmigrationen

  • Praxis im Test- und Cutover-Management sowie in klassischen, agilen und hybriden Projektvorgehensweisen

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Softwareherstellern und Implementierungspartnern sowie im Stakeholder- und Risikomanagement auf Senior-Management-Ebene

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Moderations- und Eskalationsfähigkeiten

jobs.title: Process Support Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Lam Research Salzburg GmbH - The group you'll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's panel products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor / advanced packaging industry. 1 Process Support Engineer (all genders) Job-ID: 203511 I Work Location Model: On-site I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

The impact you'll make

As a Process Support Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs.

What you'll do

* Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems

* Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements

* Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications

* Develop robust simulations to support process result understanding and suggesting next reasonable process steps to improve the performance

* Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications

* Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap

Who we're looking for

Minimum qualifications

* Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 3+ years of experience; or a PhD with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience in electrochemical metal surface deposition and/or modification

* Highly proficient in Python, COMSOL, Ansys, or other similar scientific computing language

* Creating/developing models to support obtained process results, e.g. current distribution maps

* Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies

* Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.) as well as knowledge of material analysis techniques

* Ability to work independently, high degree of flexibility and capable to work in a cross functional environment

* Structured and organized working style

* Good English oral and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

* Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques

* Background in electrochemistry, in particular electrochemical metal deposition

* Safe work with chemicals

* Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization

* Understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE)

* Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners

What we're offering

We are looking for person with combination of two following expertise areas. Knowledge / experience in both categories is mandatory but position is suitable also for freshly graduated person when background matches.

- Experience in C, C++, Python

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - West
R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

jobs.title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

jobs.title: Freelance Question Reviewers
jobs.description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

jobs.title: Residential Care Worker
jobs.description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

jobs.title: People Partner to KUKA Group
jobs.description: Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys working closely with managers and employees? Do you thrive in a hands-on role where you can combine you HR expertise with a proactive and service-minded approach?We are now looking for a Senior People Partner to join Visual Components and KUKA Group in Finland. Here, you will take on a broad and varied HR role with the opportunity to contribute to developing processes and ways of working within an international organisation.Sounds interesting? We look forward to receiving your application! ABOUT THE ROLE As Senior People Partner, you will support managers and employees across Visual Components and other KUKA businesses in Finland. You will act as a trusted point of contact for everyday HR matters, providing guidance and ensuring effective HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.The role is part of the Nordic People & Organisation (P&O) function and you will work closely with local managers, Nordic P&O colleagues and the Shared Service Centre in Hungary, contributing to consistent HR processes and ways of working.Your main responsibilities will include:• Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to managers and employees. • Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal movements, leave and offboarding. • Advise on HR policies, procedures and employee relations matters. • Coordinate local HR processes and ensure accurate employee records. • Support performance reviews, development initiatives and organisational changes.The position is based at Visual Components’ office in Espoo, Finland, and you report to the Head of P&O Nordic in Sweden. You are confident in your HR expertise, comfortable working independently and thrive in a changing international environment.We believe you have:• At least 10 years of experience in operational HR. • Broad knowledge of HR processes, employee relations and local employment practices. • Experience advising managers on a variety of HR matters. • A relevant university degree, preferably within HR. • Fluency in Finnish and English.Experience from an international matrix organisation, a technology or engineering environment, or SAP SuccessFactors is considered an advantage. Swedish language skills are also a plus.As a person, you are proactive, structured and approachable. You communicate clearly, take initiative and enjoy finding practical solutions. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues in a changing environment. CONTACT Does this opportunity sound interesting and align with your experience and ambitions? In this recruitment process, Visual Components and KUKA Group is partnering with Committo. For more information, please contact Linda Samuelsson at linda.samuelsson@committo.se or +46 702 16 37 52 or Sofia Erikson at sofia.erikson@committo.se or +46 73-642 75 69.Interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you! ABOUT THE COMPANY KUKA is a global automation corporation with sales of around 4 billion euro and approximately 15,000 employees. The company is headquartered in Augsburg, Germany. As one of the world’s leading suppliers of intelligent automation solutions, KUKA offers customers everything they need from a single source: from robots and cells to fully automated systems and their networking in markets such as automotive, electronics, metal & plastic, consumer goods, e-commerce/retail and healthcare.Visual Components is a leading developer of 3D manufacturing simulation software and solutions. Founded in 1999 by a team of simulation experts, we started with a humble goal – to make manufacturing design and simulation technology easy to use and accessible to manufacturing organizations of all sizes. Since 2017 Visual Components has been a part of KUKA Group.

jobs.title: Cultural Consultant
jobs.description:

Venue Marketing and Event Sales•    Promote the venue to corporate clients, agri-food and agtech networks, industry bodies, community groups and external event organisers, with the aim of growing event booking revenue.•    Develop and run marketing activity for the venue, including social media content, creative materials, newsletters and direct outreach.•    Conduct site tours for prospective clients, presenting the layout options, technical capability and amenities of the building.•    Create and maintain attractive event packages covering room layouts, technical setup and catering partnerships, with clear pricing.•    Manage the enquiry-to-booking process, track leads and bookings, and report regularly on occupancy and revenue.•    Build relationships with local and sector networks in the agri-food, agtech and university communities to raise the profile of the building as a destination for events.5. Financial Management/Governance and Reporting•    Report to various stakeholders both internal and external including the UCD Director of Innovation and the UCD Nova DAC board•    Process RFQs, tenders , raise requisitions and close out the purchasing process adhering to UCDs procurement process.•    Create and issue Client/Customer monthly invoices and manage and report on De Minimus passthrough.Essential Skills and Experience•    2 to 4 years’ experience in venue management, events coordination, hospitality, co-working or innovation-space operations, or a similar customer-facing role.•    Proven ability to manage a building or venue in practice: coordinating contractors, solving problems quickly and keeping standards high.•    Experience promoting a venue, service or brand through social media, networking and direct outreach, and converting enquiries into bookings.•    A friendly, confident and professional manner, with the ability to build strong relationships with start-up founders, clients and suppliers.•    Strong organisational skills and a hands-on, “no task too small” attitude. and social media tools, or a willingness to learn them quickly.•    A practical, hands-on approach to setting up rooms and equipment for events.•    Financial management, including budgeting, and reporting experience is required.•    Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for events.•    Experience working as part of a team and ability to direct staff and contractors•    Full driving licence Desirable•    Experience working in a university, innovation centre, incubator or co-working environment.•    Knowledge of, or interest in, the agri-food, agtech or veterinary sectors.•    Health and Safety or manual handling qualification, or first aid training.•    Experience of using a CRM or booking platform to manage leads and enquiries.What We Offer•    A salary of jobs.title: Driftsmedarbeidar bygg og eigedom
jobs.description:
Me søkjer ein praktisk og allsidig driftsmedarbeidar med erfaring frå bygg og vedlikehald. Stillinga omfattar dagleg drift, tilsyn og vedlikehald av BKE sine bygg og eigedomar, både innvendig og utvendig. Du vil arbeide tett saman med driftsansvarleg, som også vil vere din næraste overordna.

Hva vi ser etter

Me ser etter deg som har erfaring frå bygg, vedlikehald eller handverksfag, og som trivst med praktisk og variert arbeid.

Fagbrev innan byggfag, målarfaget eller anna relevant handverksfag er ein fordel, men relevant praktisk erfaring kan kompensere for manglande fagbrev. Du må ha førerkort kl. B.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Praktisk vedlikehald, mindre reparasjonar og bygningsmessige utbetringar

  • Måling, overflatebehandling og anna innvendig og utvendig vedlikehald

  • Plenklipping, stell av grøntområde og anna vedlikehald av uteareal

  • Tilsyn med bygg, eigedomar og tekniske anlegg

  • Registrering og oppfølging av feil og vedlikehaldsbehov i BKE sitt FDV system

  • Kontakt med leigetakarar, brukarar og leverandørar

  • Ved behov praktisk oppfølging av handverkarar og eksterne tenesteleverandørar

  • Bestilling av materiell og mindre arbeid innanfor avtalte rammer

  • Bidra til å ivareta den daglege drifta ved fråvær hos driftsansvarleg

Vi tilbyr

  • Ei stilling med ein variert arbeidskvardag og mange ulike oppgåver innan bygg, eigedom og vedlikehald

  • Eit godt og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte avgjerdsvegar og tett samarbeid

  • God opplæring og støtte frå kollegaer

  • Løn og arbeidsvilkår etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bømlo Kommunale Eigedomsselskap AS (BKE) er eit kommunalt aksjeselskap, heileigd av Bømlo kommune. BKE eig og forvaltar 156 kommunale utleigebustader, næringseigedom og tomter, med ein samla verdi på om lag 219 mill. kroner.

Hovudoppgåva til BKE er å tilby kommunale utleigebustader, trygde- og omsorgsbustader til personar som har behov for bistand på bustadmarknaden. Utleiga skjer i samarbeid med Bømlo kommune. Selskapet kan også utvikle, drifte, vedlikehalde og forvalte andre eigedomar til kommunale føremål.

BKE er ein liten organisasjon med korte avgjerdsvegar og tett samarbeid. Me held til i Hollundsdalen på Bømlo.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

jobs.title: Facility Director
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Director, you will lead Nordscale’s Facility Management unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the  unit ahead of and during the start of operations. You will hold overall responsibility for safe and stable operation of the facility, the buildings and the services around them, around the clock.

 

You will report to the Site Director and lead managers within quality, HSE, site coordination and logistics, sustainability and technical operations. 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the Facility Management unit, and prepare the organisation, procedures and suppliers for the start of operations in 2027.
  • Hold overall responsibility for safe, stable and efficient 24/7 operation of the facility. This includes building and site services such as property management, security, logistics, spare parts and sustainability.
  • Own the operational management system, including KPIs, meeting structure, reporting and follow-up. Build a strong safety and quality culture with strict operational discipline, and act as Incident Commander during major incidents.
  • Work closely with the Site Director, Nscale and IT teams. Manage supplier performance and budgets for maintenance, upgrades, energy and technical services. 

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

 You may be an experienced leader from data centres. You may also come from other technically complex, continuous operations where downtime has major consequences, such as process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, offshore, maritime operations, power or technical defence environments. Experience from establishing an operating organisation before a facility enters regular operation is an advantage. 

You are motivated by building something from the ground up, and you combine trust with clear follow-up. You know that following the standard and improving it are equally important parts of the same responsibility.

 

Key characteristics

  •  Structured and systematic, working with strong procedural discipline and attention to detail.
  • Resilient under pressure, identifying challenges and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.
  • Builds relationships of trust, collaboration and mutual respect, communicates clearly and listens actively.

 

Skills & Qualifications 

  •  Solid experience leading managers across several technical disciplines and support functions in 24/7 operations, together with subcontractors.
  • A strong track record in safety culture and HSE, including work and access permits, safe isolation, risk assessment and change management.
  • Experience with establishing and leading a performance management system, policies and procedures (SOPs etc) and supplier follow-up
  • Sound understanding of electrical, cooling and mechanical systems.
  • Experience from commissioning and start-up is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. 
  • A master’s degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering is preferred. Other relevant technical education combined with documented operational experience will also be considered. 
What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the operating organisation, procedures and safety culture from the ground up, and to lead Kvandal South into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.  
Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Oulaisiin
jobs.description: **Haemme ammattisiivoojaa avustamaan asiakastamme Oulaisissa.** **Mitä siivooja-helpperi tekee?** Siivooja-helpperi on henkilö, joka tukee asiakkaitamme ammatillisessa kotisiivouksessa. Asiakkaamme saa aina oman helpperinsä avukseen. Työ on mielekästä, sillä helpperinä pääset myös tutustumaan asiakkaaseen.Hemby tarjoaa kotisiivouksia tekeville helppereillemme laadukkaat siivousvälineet mikrokuituliinoista pesuaineisiin. Kotisiivouskäynneillä hyödynnämme asiakkaan imuria ja moppia lattioiden siistimiseen.**Mitä työ vaatii?** Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta. Lisäksi asiakaspalveluhenkisyys sekä reipas ote ovat työssä tarvittavia ominasuuksia. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat. Edellytämme työntekijöiltämme 18-vuoden ikää.**Mikä on Hemby?**Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme.**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:_"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."__"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."__Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan._**Siivooja-helpperinä saat:**- **Omat nimetyt asiakkaat**, joita autat kotisiivouksessa. - **Joustavat työajat,** jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa 2-6 tunnin ajan, riippuen asiakkaan asunnon koosta. - **Kilpailukykyisen palkan:** Tuntipalkka 13,20€-15,98€/h + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. - **Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet:** Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän työpanoksesi ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! - **Monipuolisen työn:** siivoojana voit halutessasi myös olla avuksi asiakkaillemme arjen muissa askareissa. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksiHakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. jobs.title: Outcomes Architect, Nordics (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3+ years experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working
   
   

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale.

 - Fluency in additional languages

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €94,000-€105,000per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: DGI Storkøbenhavn søger idrætskonsulent til gymnastik (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeninger?

Har du en faglighed inden for gymnastik og et stærkt foreningskendskab? 

Brænder du for at sammensætte og drive de helt rigtige kurser og uddannelser?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Storkøbenhavn.

Vi søger en konsulent, som kan arbejde strategisk og er en drivkraft i udviklingen af gymnastikken i Storkøbenhavn. Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med gymnastikforeningerne om udvikling, aktiviteter og uddannelse af instruktører og ledere.Du understøtter gymnastikforeningerne i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner og rådgiver. Du skal derfor kunne skabe gode relationer til nøglepersoner i gymnastikforeningerne samtidig med, at du kan inddrage kolleger med forskellige andre fagligheder. 

Det er især vigtigt, at du kan drive og udvikle vores kursus- og uddannelsesområde, så vores tilbud til gymnastikforeninger, frivillige og instruktører er attraktive og af høj kvalitet. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at

  • løbende kvalificere vores udbud af kurser og uddannelser
  • afdække behov hos foreninger og omsætte dem til relevante tilbud
  • udvikle nye kurser, uddannelser og skræddersyede forløb
  • rekruttere de rette undervisere og samarbejde tæt med dem
  • arbejde med synlighed og øge deltagelsen på vores kurser

DGI Storkøbenhavn har desuden indgået en række kommunepartnerskaber med henblik på at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for foreningsidrætten lokalt. I den forbindelse samarbejder vi med stærke og toneangivende foreninger om deres specifikke udfordringer og potentialer. En del af de foreninger er gymnastikforeninger, hvorfor du får en central rolle i disse udviklingsprocesser. 

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab i DGI Storkøbenhavns idrætsteam og vil også arbejde sammen med administrative medarbejdere og foreningskonsulenter.  

Din profil:

  • Faglig viden om gymnastik og ambitioner for udvikling af idrætten
  • Et skarpt blik for både udvikling og udbredelse af kurser og uddannelser
  • Erfaring som konsulent eller projektleder – du ved, hvordan man skaber fremdrift og resultater
  • Erfaring med foreningsudvikling og gerne kendskab til gymnastikforeningerne i Storkøbenhavn
  • En udadvendt og opsøgende tilgang – du trives med at skabe relationer og netværk
  • Kompetent bruger af administrative systemer

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt. Tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027. 

Det er en tidsbegrænset stilling med udløb 31. marts 2028.

Aften- og weekendarbejde vil forekomme. 

 

DGI Storkøbenhavn

Som idrætsforeningernes udviklingshus styrker vi idrætsforeningerne i en by i konstant forandring. Vi dækker 11 kommuner og repræsenterer ca. 650 idrætsforeninger, der samlet set har mere end 300.000 medlemmer. Vi oplever vækst i medlemstal og samarbejder tæt med foreninger og kommuner om de lokale udviklingsmuligheder.

Vi tilbyder et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø med ca. 55 passionerede medarbejdere og mange frivillige. Kontoret ligger i moderne lokaler centralt i København på Vesterbrogade lige overfor Hovedbanegården.

 

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist er onsdag den 2. december.

Vi holder samtaler mandag den 7. december og anden samtaler torsdag den 10. december.

jobs.title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

jobs.title: Kok med smag for mere fritid?
jobs.description:
Café OVER-TID i Juelsminde søger endnu en kok, ernæringsassistent eller erfaren køkkenfaglig kollega.

Du holder af at lave ordentlig mad. Af at smage til, bage fra bunden og sende et måltid afsted, du er stolt af. Og du vil gerne have tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

Hos Café OVER-TID får du begge dele: et køkken med forskellige opgaver og plads til dine idéer – og en arbejdsrytme med weekendvagt hver femte weekend, kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret og mindre arbejde fra påske til september.

Fra surdej til selskaber

Du finder os i Juelsminde Hallerne, hvor Café OVER-TID samler mennesker om mad og fællesskab. Køkkenet laver både mad til caféens gæster, Take Away, mad ud af huset, selskaber, møder og events. Vi står også for frokostordninger til virksomheder, blandt andre JUAL.

Vi laver mad fra bunden og bager selv vores brød – gerne med surdej. Her får du brugt dit håndværk på tværs af hverdagsmad, caféretter og selskabsmenuer. Og du får mulighed for at præge menuerne, ugens retter og måden, vi arbejder på.

God mad. Og tid til andet.

Arbejdet følger husets sæson. Vi arbejder mere om vinteren og har nedsat arbejdstid fra påske til september, så der er ekstra tid til at nyde de varme dage.

●     Weekendvagt hver femte weekend.

●     Kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret.

●     Færre arbejdstimer fra påske til september.

●     Et lille team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og giver plads til faglige input.

●     Indflydelse på maden og arbejdsgangene i køkkenet.

Der er også travle dage og arrangementer, der kræver, at vi løfter sammen. Du får en hverdag med både planlagt produktion og gæster i huset.

Du kan dit håndværk – og tager ansvar

Du er kok, ernæringsassistent, cater eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken. Det afgørende er, at du kan lave velsmagende mad fra bunden og arbejde selvstændigt med kvalitet og overblik.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

●     Kan planlægge og tilberede mad til både daglig drift og arrangementer.

●     Har styr på hygiejne, egenkontrol og orden i køkkenet.

●     Tager initiativ og har lyst til at bidrage med idéer.

●     Hjælper kollegerne og bevarer overblikket, når der er flere ting i gang.

●     Trives med gæstekontakt og livet i et hus med børn, unge og voksne.

Du bliver en del af hverdagen i både køkkenet og caféen. Vi deles om opgaverne, så både maden, servicen og samarbejdet fungerer.

Lad os tage en snak

Har du lyst til at se køkkenet og høre mere om jobbet? Ring til centerchef Britta Roslyng på 44 14 36 10. Vi tager gerne en uformel snak over en kop kaffe.

Du kan også sende dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din køkkenerfaring til brg@jhacenter.dk.

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Arbejdssted: Café OVER-TID, Juelsminde Hallerne, Tofteskovvej 12, 7130 Juelsminde.
